  • Method Details

    • toSlug

      public static String toSlug(String text)
      Converts a string into a URL-friendly slug. Rules: - Trims and converts to lowercase - Strips accents/diacritics - Replaces spaces and underscores with single hyphen '-' - Strips non-alphanumeric characters (except hyphen) - Collapses consecutive hyphens into one and trims leading/trailing hyphens
      Parameters:
      text - the input string
      Returns:
      URL slug, or empty string if input is null/blank

    • capitalizeWords

      public static String capitalizeWords(String input)
      Capitalizes the first letter of each word in a string, with the rest lowercase. Example: "jOHn dOE" -> "John Doe"
      Parameters:
      input - the input string
      Returns:
      capitalized string, or empty string if null

    • truncate

      public static String truncate(String text, int maxLength, String suffix)
      Truncates a string to a maximum length and appends a suffix (e.g. "..."). If the string length is less than or equal to maxLength, it is returned as-is. If truncation occurs, the returned string total length (including suffix) will not exceed maxLength.
      Parameters:
      text - the text to truncate
      maxLength - maximum allowed length (must be >= suffix length)
      suffix - string to append (e.g. "...")
      Returns:
      truncated string
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if maxLength is negative or less than suffix length

    • countOccurrences

      public static int countOccurrences(String text, String sub)
      Counts occurrences of a substring within a text (case-sensitive).
      Parameters:
      text - the full text
      sub - the substring to count
      Returns:
      number of occurrences (0 if text/sub is null or empty)

    • isPalindrome

      public static boolean isPalindrome(String text)
      Checks if a string is a palindrome, ignoring case, spaces, and punctuation. Examples: "Racecar" -> true, "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama" -> true.
      Parameters:
      text - the string to evaluate
      Returns:
      true if palindrome, false otherwise (null returns false)

    • maskCreditCard

      public static String maskCreditCard(String cardNumber)
      Masks a credit card or account number, keeping only the last 4 digits visible. Strips non-digits first. If digits count is less than 4, masks all digits. Example: "4111 2222 3333 4444" -> "************4444"
      Parameters:
      cardNumber - the card number string
      Returns:
      masked string

    • reverseWords

      public static String reverseWords(String sentence)
      Reverses the words in a sentence preserving single spaces between words. Example: "The quick brown fox" -> "fox brown quick The"
      Parameters:
      sentence - the input sentence
      Returns:
      reversed words sentence, or empty string if null/blank
